review.rationale: Methodological contract for Test Card T002. The evidence decision lives in docs/standard. Photometry, membership, completeness and stellar-model physics are inherited from the published analyses.

question: Does the layer-3 abundance law N = b F/P (Little's law with exhaustion lifetimes) reproduce the observed globular-cluster ratio R = N_HB/N_RGB?

output.quantity: R = N_HB / N_RGB(upper) and its standardized deviation z
output.domain: 39 Galactic globular clusters with [M/H] < -1.1; stars of 0.82-0.84 Msun
output.accuracy: Combined 1-sigma from the observed mean and the helium input; stellar-model fit uncertainty not quoted and not included.

model.assumptions: Common formation rate through RGB and HB; phase lifetimes from published stellar models (fuel/luminosity); a single He abundance per cluster sample.
model.approximation: Linear fit R_th(Y) = 6.26 Y - 0.12 from stellar models without extra energy sinks.
model.initial_boundary: Old clusters; steady flow through post-main-sequence phases.
model.drive_environment: None beyond the published cluster populations.
model.parameters: No fitting; Y from independent H II regions (primary) and SBBN (sensitivity only).

data_policy.holdout_policy: No holdout. Published comparison seen before drafting (exposure SEEN_FULL), declared in Test Card T002.

system_partition.boundary: Published star counts in 39 globular clusters, observed photometrically; the comparison uses the published mean R and model fit, not raw photometry.

systems.state: Joint description of a cluster population, not an extra state

state_accounting.rule: Each star is counted once, in the phase it occupies.

systems.state: Stars on the upper red giant branch (H-shell burning)
Stars on the horizontal branch (core He burning)

state_accounting.rule: Observer record only; carries no stellar energy.

couplings.map: Each star leaves the RGB tip and enters the HB (helium flash); common flow rate b
Starlight with reddening and distance handled upstream

observables.backaction_scope_reason: Both counted owners are assessed; the cluster aggregate is a nonadditive view.
observables.readout_map: Published counts (Salaris et al. 2004) averaged by Ayala et al. 2014; transcribed only

observation.source_state: Stellar populations as modelled by the published analyses.
observation.generated_trace: Starlight; not a UET trace variable.
observation.carrier: Photons; not identified with any UET field.
observation.readout: Published mean R and stellar-model fit.
observation.frame: Cluster rest frame of the published analysis
observation.time_convention: Stellar-evolution time of the published models

error_budget.approximation: Linear R_th(Y) fit; validity range declared by the source.
error_budget.measurement: Observed mean R 1-sigma and helium 1-sigma propagated in quadrature.
error_budget.systematic: Stellar-model fit uncertainty not quoted by the source and not included; journal cross-check not done.
error_budget.omissions: Possible He-enhanced subpopulations and extra energy sinks (for example axions) are not modelled.
error_budget.dependence: Observed counts and helium measurements are independent datasets.
error_budget.acceptance: Outcome categories fixed in Test Card T002 (z <= 2 PASS, 2 < z <= 3 INCONCLUSIVE, z > 3 FAIL).

claim_boundary: Methodological coverage of the T002 comparison only. The evidence level is set in docs/standard. The comparison cannot distinguish UET layer 3 from the standard fuel-consumption reasoning it reproduces.
next_action: Cross-check transcribed values against the journal version; add a stellar-model systematic if a quoted value is found.
